JOIN

Make materials.
Measure them carefully.
Let the data decide.

We are looking for people who like making things in the lab and are curious about what the numbers say afterwards. Chemistry, materials, chemical engineering, physics and computer science backgrounds all fit.

직접 만들고, 꼼꼼히 재고, 데이터로 판단하는 사람을 찾습니다.

OPEN POSITIONS

  • Ph.D. and M.S. studentsMaterials synthesis, electrochemistry, or machine learning for materials. Admission is through the Dankook University graduate program; contact us before applying.
  • Undergraduate researchersSemester or summer research on a defined project, with a real result at the end: a dataset, a material, or a figure in a paper.
  • Postdoctoral researchersOpenings depend on funding. Candidates with sol–gel synthesis, electrocatalysis or machine-learning experience are encouraged to write.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Care in the lab and honesty with data, including the results that did not work.
  • Willingness to learn across a boundary: a synthetic chemist who writes a script, a coder who runs a furnace.
  • Clear writing, in English or Korean.

HOW TO APPLY

  • Send a CV, a transcript, and a one-page note on what you want to work on and why here.
  • Name one paper from the publications that you found interesting, and say what you would do next.
  • Expect a reply within two weeks and, if there is a fit, a conversation.
